outcome: postoperative analgesia (duration to first rescue analgesic)
cohort: The study included 120 full-term parturients undergoing elective cesarean sections under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Intrathecal dexmedetomidine (5 mg) prolonged motor and sensory blockade, provided a similar analgesic effect, and reduced the incidence of pruritus and shivering compared with intrathecal morphine (100 mg) in cesarean sections.
